verifier_values.criteria: Does a declared symlink output that is an actual symlink on disk get its target path recorded in the log?

verifier_custom_field_values.reason_a: A adds symlink_target_path to the File message and logs it when a declared symlink output is found to be a symlink on disk, via its logSymlink helper in the compact context and a matching branch in the expanded one.
verifier_custom_field_values.reason_b: Yes. I found the code in B's transcript rather than its patch - the harness reconstruction only kept the proto and two imports, but B reads its own files back and the lines are there. In the UNRESOLVED_SYMLINK branch it calls addActualOutputsBuilder().setPath(output.getExecPathString()).setSymlinkTargetPath(path.readSymbolicLink().getPathString()), so the target is written, and File.symlink_target_path is in the proto it extended.
